description: Καταγραφή ευπαθών περιοχών για την αντιμετώπιση πλημμυρικών φαινομένων στα διοικητικά όρια του Δήμου is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ΤΜΗΜΑ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝΤΟΣ ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΑΣ & ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΗΣ ΠΡΟΣΤΑΣΙΑΣ. Les archives comprennent des zones vulnérables pour faire face aux inondations dans les limites administratives de la municipalité. Coverage: ΤΜΗΜΑ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝΤΟΣ ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΑΣ & ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΗΣ ΠΡΟΣΤΑΣΙΑΣ. The portal shows the English title as "To jutīgo teritoriju saraksts, kuras pašvaldības administratīvajās robežās ir pakļautas plūdiem" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ΤΜΗΜΑ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝΤΟΣ ΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΑΣ & ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΗΣ ΠΡΟΣΤΑΣΙΑΣ. Its keywords include Περιβάλλον, Πολιτική προστασία, repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 2026-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
